reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the finding correctly proposes no redline and no counterparty comment, consistent with the playbook's handling of compliant items as internal evidence only.

The cited text (Section 12.3) affirmatively records that Customer has made no no-hire commitment and preserves Customer's freedom to hire anyone responding to general recruitment, supporting the preferred position 'No non-solicit on Customer'; the clause runs in our favour and should not be flagged.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months; general-solicitation carve-out) are properly explained as non-probative: both regexes presuppose an existing restrictive covenant, and none binds Customer in the cited text.
Rendered redline is identical to the original paragraph, so there is no invalid or directionally wrong edit; rationale is accurate and appropriately scoped to employee non-solicitation only.
